description.zh:
证书唯一识别码。该参数可通过调用[ListCert](~~455806~~)获取。
- SSL证书识别码一般为{证书ID}-cn-hangzhou。
- PCA证书为对应私有证书的Identifier字段。
description.en:
The unique identifier of the certificate. You can call the [ListCert](~~455806~~) operation to obtain the identifier.

*   If the certificate is an SSL certificate, the value of this parameter must be in the {Certificate ID}-cn-hangzhou format.
*   If the certificate is a private certificate, the value of this parameter must be the value of the Identifier field for the private certificate.

description.zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键。

待签名数据。可以使用原文、Base64、哈希值三种格式进行传输。
当MessageType取值为RAW时，Message传原文字符串。
当MessageType取值为BASE64时，Message传原文的base64值。
当MessageType取值为DIGEST时，Message传哈希值，对消息摘要进行签名。
description.en:
The data to sign. The value must be encoded in Base64.\
For example, if the hexadecimal data that you want to sign is \[0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x34], set the parameter to the Base64-encoded value MTIzNA==. If you set MessageType to RAW, the size of the data must be less than 4 KB. If the size of the data is greater than 4 KB, you can set MessageType to DIGEST and set Message to the digest of the data. The digest is a hash value. You can compute the digest of the data on an on-premises machine. The certificate application repository uses the digest that you compute in your own certificate application system. The message digest algorithm that you use must match the specified signature algorithm. The following items describe the details:

*   If the signature algorithm is SHA256withRSA, SHA256withRSA/PSS, or SHA256withECDSA, the message digest algorithm must be SHA-256.
*   If the signature algorithm is SM3withSM2, the message digest algorithm must be SM3.

description.zh:
消息类型。取值：

- RAW（默认值）：原始数据。
- DIGEST：原始数据的消息摘要（哈希值）。
- BASE64：原文base64。
description.en:
The value type of the Message parameter. Valid values:

*   RAW: the raw data. This is the default value.
*   DIGEST: the message digest (hash value) of the raw data.

description.zh:
签名算法。取值：

- SHA256withRSA
- SHA256withRSA/PSS
- SHA256withECDSA
- SM3withSM2
- SHA256withRSA/P7
description.en:
The signature algorithm. Valid values:

*   SHA256withRSA
*   SHA256withRSA/PSS
*   SHA256withECDSA
*   SM3withSM2

description.zh:
仓库ID。
> 此ID可通过调用[ListCertWarehouse ](~~455805~~)获取。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cas sign --message MTIzNA== --cert-identifier 1ef1da5f-38ed-69b3-0000-037781890265 --signing-algorithm SHA256withRSA --message-type RAW --custom-identifier 000e6bb538d538c70c01f81fg30000 --warehouse-id 1 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cas Sign --region cn-hangzhou --Message 'MTIzNA==' --CertIdentifier '1ef1da5f-38ed-69b3-0000-037781890265' --SigningAlgorithm SHA256withRSA --WarehouseId 1 --CustomIdentifier 000e6bb538d538c70c01f81fg30000 --MessageType RAW
